function.name: getMeter
function.description: Read one energy meter and its tariff.

meterId.description: Meter identifier; opaque identifier, copy exactly, e.g. MTR-7001

fields.description: Optional projection: subset of record keys to return; allowed keys: meterId, site, tariffCode; omit for full records

function.name: listReadings
function.description: Return matching meter readings in an inclusive instant window and their summed kWh. The total covers the returned rows after all filters and the limit.

meterId.description: Meter identifier; opaque identifier, copy exactly, e.g. MTR-7001

fromInstant.description: Window start, inclusive; full instant YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM with zone Z or +HH:MM, never date-only

toInstant.description: Window end, inclusive; full instant YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM with zone Z or +HH:MM, never date-only

minKwh.description: Minimum reading kwh, decimal JSON number allowed, 0..1000

limit.description: Max rows to return, non-negative integer 0..50; omit for all rows

tariffCode.description: Tariff code; one of: flat, day_night, spot

function.name: listOutages
function.description: List outages of one status, optionally starting on/after a date.

status.description: Outage status; one of: planned, active, restored

afterDate.description: Only outages starting on/after this date; date-only YYYY-MM-DD, never a timestamp

limit.description: Max rows to return, non-negative integer 0..50; omit for all rows
